title: podman pull to include architecture variants for all platforms by default
body:
### Feature request description

The OCI image spec[1] now includes platform variants for non-aarch64 platforms.

To support this fully, `podman pull`, should include the variant for all platforms per the specification.

As distros start to have a default minimum microarchitecture, like RHEL10 with x86_64 being v3+, helping users avoid downtime by being explicit of the microarchitecture at retrieval time would be useful.

Thankfully can be explicitly done. Being more explicit removes the burden of a user diagnosing a SIGILL/SEGV when an unsupported image is retrieved.
```
$ podman   pull --variant v3  registry.access.redhat.com/ubi10/ubi
Trying to pull registry.access.redhat.com/ubi10/ubi:latest...
Getting image source signatures
Checking if image destination supports signatures
Copying blob 1f0d847c2422 skipped: already exists  
Copying config 76819081c1 done   | 
Writing manifest to image destination
Storing signatures
WARNING: image platform (linux/amd64) does not match the expected platform (linux/amd64/v3)
```

Obviously registries will need to start being more explicit too.

its was pointed out that containerd/ https://github.com/containerd/platforms and other parts may been to be updated first.

In the meantime the fallback, (client or registry?) seems to work ok with warning.

[1] https://specs.opencontainers.org/image-spec/image-index/#platform-variants
